episodeTitle.en: Be fundamentally different, not incrementally better | Jag Duggal (Nubank, Facebook, Google)
episodeTitle.zh: 像杰克·杜加尔（Nubank、Facebook、谷歌）那样：从根本上与众不同，而非渐进式改进

guestBioOfficial.en: Jag Duggal is chief product officer at Nubank, a decacorn neobank founded in Brazil. It’s valued at over $30 billion, is bigger than Coinbase, Robinhood, Affirm, and SoFi combined, has 100 million customers (more than Bank of America!) while only operating in three countries in Latin America, and 80% to 90% of its growth comes through word of mouth. Prior to Nubank, Jag was a director of product management at Facebook, a senior vice president at Quantcast, and a product leader at Google. In our conversation, we discuss: • How Nubank builds a fanatical user base
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰克·杜加尔是Nubank的首席产品官，Nubank是一家成立于巴西的独角兽新银行。其估值超过300亿美元，规模超过Coinbase、Robinhood、Affirm和SoFi的总和，仅在拉丁美洲三个国家开展业务，80%至90%的增长来自口碑。在加入Nubank之前，杰克曾担任Facebook的产品管理总监、Quantcast的高级副总裁，以及谷歌的产品负责人。在我们的对话中，我们将探讨：• Nubank如何建立狂热的用户基础

title.en: Be fundamentally different, not incrementally better | Jag Duggal (Nubank, Facebook, Google)
title.zh: 像杰克·杜加尔（Nubank、Facebook、谷歌）那样：从根本上与众不同，而非渐进式改进

summary.en: Jag explains how Nubank wins not by being incrementally better but fundamentally different, earning fanatical love (80–90% of growth is word of mouth) and only scaling a product line once its Sean Ellis score crosses a compelling threshold. He discusses how to develop a clear strategy (channeling Kevin Systrom's 'at least we are clear'), category design, and disciplined product-line expansion into lending, investing, insurance, and small business. The conversation is a masterclass in building products people love and in the future of FinTech out of Latin America.
summary.zh: Jag 解释了 Nubank 何以胜出：不是“好一点”，而是“根本不同”，从而赢得狂热的喜爱（80%–90% 的增长来自口碑），并且只有当某个产品线的 Sean Ellis 分数越过有说服力的门槛后才会扩张。他谈到了如何制定清晰的战略（借鉴 Kevin Systrom 的“至少我们是清晰的”）、品类设计，以及向借贷、投资、保险和小企业业务的有纪律的品类扩张。这期对话是关于“打造人们热爱的产品”以及拉美金融科技未来的公开课。
